metadata.title: Soft-Focus Studio Portrait with Warm Lighting

retrievalProfile.description: A centered, medium close-up portrait featuring soft, warm directional lighting and a shallow depth of field against a muted gradient background.
excludeWhen: vibrant neon color palettes are required

recipe.visualDefinition: A head-and-shoulders portrait of a man with reddish-brown hair and round spectacles, wearing a dark turtleneck. The lighting is soft and warm, coming from the upper right, creating gentle shadows and a subtle glow on the skin. The background is a non-distracting, dark grey-to-brown gradient.
coreVisualRelationships: warm highlights contrasting with dark clothing
soft focus transition between subject and background

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject occupies the central 60% of the frame in a medium close-up shot.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The eyes, framed by round glasses, serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The viewer's eye starts at the face, follows the light down the bridge of the nose, and rests on the dark silhouette of the shoulders.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Balanced negative space on either side of the head provides a sense of calm and focus.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm skin tones and reddish-brown hair (mid-tones)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Golden-yellow highlights from the studio lamp
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with a compressed value range to maintain a soft, film-like quality.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a soft-focus studio portrait of a man with reddish-brown hair and round glasses wearing a black turtleneck against a dark gradient background with warm side-lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: If text is required, use a clean, light-weight serif font in a muted cream color, positioned in the lower third or upper corner to avoid obscuring the face.

verificationChecks: Ensure lighting is diffused and warm
Check that the background is a smooth gradient
Verify the subject is centered and looking forward

mustAchieve: Natural skin texture under soft light

postGenerationChecks: Is the lighting direction consistent across the face?
Are the glasses symmetrical and properly seated?
Is the transition between the hair and background soft?
Does the turtleneck maintain a solid, dark value without losing all detail?
recipe.reuseFormula: Soft Studio Portrait = (Centered Subject + Warm Key Light) / (Muted Gradient Background + Shallow Depth of Field)
